name: smwgraphics-tiny-toon-adventures-buster-busts-loose-cafeteria
title: Tiny Toon Adventures: Buster Busts Loose! - Cafeteria
description:
This BG is seen where Buster 'fights' Dizzy, using food that shows up when available. Originally, this BG was just enough for the boss battle, if not more. I decided to do the rest of the BG myself. While it was annoying, it turned out well. The only reason I selected palette 4 is because the BG is meant for a boss. Also uses almost all of palettes 3, 7 and all of palette 5. Use a boss that ends the level or make a block that sends the player to the OW. Otherwise is possible.
Consumes 1 Map16 page and over a half.

Have fun using it!
